title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-08-14
headline: He's been frozen on Everest for thirty years, now 'Green Boots' may finally be coming home

questions.prompt: Who is the Indian climber known as Green Boots?
questions.hintKo: The body is believed to be Dorje Morup.

questions.prompt: What does India plan to do with the body?
choices: Leave it on the mountain forever
Retrieve it and bring it home
questions.hintKo: India plans to recover the body and return it to the family.

questions.prompt: When did the climber die on Everest?
Where has the body been lying for thirty years?
choices: At the bottom of a crevasse
Under an overhanging rock near the summit
questions.hintKo: The body rests under an overhanging rock near the summit.

questions.prompt: Why do authorities believe the body belongs to Morup?
choices: Because of testimony from survivors and the location of the last radio contact
Because of the color of the boots
Because of a passport found nearby
Because of a DNA test in a laboratory
Because his family climbed up to see it
questions.hintKo: Survivor testimony and the last radio contact location support the identification.

questions.prompt: How will the recovery team bring the body down?
choices: They will fly a helicopter directly to the body
They will carry it down to an altitude where a helicopter or yaks can collect it
They will push it down the mountain
They will wait for the snow to melt
They will leave it for the next season
questions.hintKo: The body must be carried down to a lower altitude for collection.
